Hi all — attached is the draft calculation and supporting files for IonLogic. Summary below (attachment: sla-offset-calculation-IONlogic.xlsx):

Summary of approach
- Baseline SLA: 99.95% monthly uptime
- Observed window: 2026-09-17T01:10:00Z — 2026-09-17T03:45:00Z (total affected minutes 155)
- Billable tokens during affected window: 1,203,402 tokens (customer-provided plus server logs cross-checked)
- Pro-rated offset method: (SLA shortfall %) * (billable spend during affected window)

Numbers (high level)
- Monthly expected uptime: 30 days * 24h * 60m = 43,200 minutes
- Shortfall minutes attributable to Redwood: 155
- Shortfall fraction = 155 / 43,200 = 0.00359 (0.359%)
- Customer billable spend for the window (token-rate normalized) = $9,870.40
- Proposed credit = 0.00359 * $9,870.40 = $35.45 -> rounded to $35.45 (our policy rounds to nearest cent)

Notes/assumptions
- We only credit usage attributable to Redwood-hosted inference calls in the affected region (us-west-2). Cross-region failovers where requests were successfully routed are excluded.
- We validated error traces against your evidence bundle; attached evidence-log-20260917.zip contains request ids we used for cross-checks.
- Because the computed credit is small (< $100) the standard PO requirement is waived, per our credit policy (see small-credit waiver).

Attachments included:
- sla-offset-calculation-IONlogic.xlsx (Excel: detailed token math, per-request sample IDs)
- evidence-log-20260917.zip (ionlogic sample traces + our matched logs)
- signed-mop.pdf (relevant MOP excerpt showing the affected maintenance window)

Requesting approval to instruct Billing to post a $35.45 credit to IonLogic’s account and to confirm once issued. If approved I will open the billing ticket and reference HubSpot company record.
